event_detail: Top drawer of the island drawer stack: the gripper holds its handle at 14.4-16.0 s. Between 16.0 and 17.6 s the drawer comes out only a short distance, and the gripper then lets go and drops below it. At 19.2 s the hand is at the island corner beside the drawer, which is only partly open.
evidence: At 14.4/16.0 s the wrist view shows the white handle between the fingers. In the left shoulder view the top handle then shifts down/toward the camera and hides the second handle by 17.6 s, which means a small pull-out. The wrist view at 17.6 s shows closed-looking drawer fronts with no drawer interior, and the gripper is no longer on the handle. No straw is visible in the gripper at any time. Because the arm hides much of the drawer, the exact opening amount is uncertain: it could be open enough for the robot to reach in.
